A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ThinkingViT. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support comparison, including content moved or renumbered in v3.

before.justification: v2 reports original classification, semantic segmentation, efficiency, robustness, and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds ImageNet-21K experiments in Appendix I.

M1.justification: Nested head expansion, Token Recycling, the joint training objective, entropy-based stopping, and batched inference remain unchanged. The projection caption and forward/backward-pass description clarify the existing procedure.

E1.justification: New Appendix I adds training and evaluation on ImageNet-21K, substantially broadening classification coverage to a label space with an order of magnitude more classes. The original ImageNet-1K variants, ADE20K, and Cityscapes coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding existing comparisons retain their comparator sets, including DynaBERT-S in Figure 15. The new ImageNet-21K comparison uses already evaluated MatFormer, HydraViT, and DeiT-Tiny/Small; newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The new ImageNet-21K experiment introduces a shuffled split of 12,741,248 training and 411,008 validation images, training from scratch for 150 epochs, and global batch size 2048. Existing experiments retain their stated protocols.

E4.justification: Appendix J adds a quantitative training-overhead comparison: 20 minutes per epoch for ThinkingViT versus 7 and 13 minutes for separately training DeiT-Tiny and DeiT-Small. Existing recycling, fusion, robustness, prediction-dynamics, and head-expansion analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-seed estimates, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Removing the approximate count of 100 prototyping runs does not change statistical replication reporting for the reported experiments.

E6.justification: Table 3 corrects second-round usage at entropy threshold 0.1 from 71.7% to 91.7%, retaining the accuracy and GMACs. New Figure 16 reports ImageNet-21K results, including 41.9% accuracy near 4.6 GMACs versus MatFormer's 39.8% and HydraViT's 39.4%. These are additional benchmark results, not same-setting improvements over v2.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and Equations (1)-(6) are retained, with no new assumptions, proofs, or derivations. Explicitly identifying the initial state as z0 = ED clarifies existing notation.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same methodological contributions, transfer claims, and headline gains of up to 2.0 percentage points at equal throughput and 2.9 at equal GMACs. Adding these existing numbers to the conclusion does not change the core claims.

C2.justification: Appendix I interprets the new results as evidence of generalization to larger class spaces. Appendix J qualifies the training-overhead discussion by claiming comparable cost to separately training the two constituent model sizes, and Appendix D slightly expands the explanation of why layerwise recycling underperforms.

D1.justification: v3 adds the ImageNet-21K data-source link and explicit split/training instructions, and newly documents the two-stage forward pass, single backward pass, and comparative training times. It removes v2's disclosure of roughly 100 prototyping runs lasting 300 epochs each.

R1.justification: Appendix G adds citations to Dynamic Perceiver, Glance and Focus, and Not All Images Are Worth 16x16 Words. These modestly extend the supporting literature while preserving the positioning of image-level routing as complementary to token-level adaptation.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized grammar and terminology edits, adds an author affiliation, clarifies several explanations, and expands the conclusion using existing findings. The new Appendix I shifts subsequent appendix labels, while the main narrative structure remains stable.

P2.justification: v3 adds the ImageNet-21K plot as Figure 16 and retains the former Figure 16 as Figure 17. Existing plots receive localized sizing, tick, and marker changes, and Tables 6 and 7 are regrouped on the final page without changing their results.

improvement.justification: The ImageNet-21K experiment supplies useful evidence for broader classification scalability, and the Table 3 correction makes routing usage consistent with the reported GMACs. These strengthen empirical support and internal consistency. The gains are limited by unchanged core evidence and an unresolved reporting ambiguity: Appendix J's new 20-minute epoch time is not reconciled with Section 4.1's retained 10-minute figure on two GPUs.
